item.title: Cumulus Media Appoints Carol Flaton to Board of Directors
item.description: ATLANTA, Jan. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Cumulus Media Inc. (OTCQB: CMLS) today announced the appointment of Carol Flaton to its Board of Directors. Flaton’s appointment follows the resignation of Joan Hogan Gillman from the Board. Both changes are effective January 15, 2026. The post Cumulus Media Appoints Carol Flaton to Board of Directors first appeared on Cumulus Media.

item.title: Cumulus DFW Radio Stations Raise Over $3.5 Million for DFW Charities in 2025
item.description: DALLAS, TX, January 19, 2026 — Cumulus Media (OTCQB: CMLS) announces that its Dallas-Fort Worth, TX radio station group raised a total of $3,559,468 for DFW Metroplex charities during 2025. In addition, Cumulus Dallas-Fort Worth supported signature community events with other groups to help raise additional millions in charitable donations. The post Cumulus DFW Radio Stations Raise Over $3.5 Million for DFW Charities in 2025 first appeared on Cumulus Media.

item.title: Broadcast Software International Launches BSI Stratus Music Scheduling: A Smarter Way to Schedule Radio Music
item.description: Eugene, OR – January 19, 2026 — Broadcast Software International (BSI), a trusted name in radio automation and broadcast solutions, is proud to announce the launch of BSI Stratus Music Scheduling, a powerful new software product especially designed to revolutionize how radio stations manage and schedule their music.
